name: @gameflex/remote-browser
description: Gameflex remote browser streaming prototype: host session gateway + dockerised Chromium runner.

scripts.sandbox:check: docker run --rm --cap-drop ALL --security-opt seccomp=runner/seccomp/chromium-sandbox.json --shm-size 512m --pids-limit 256 --memory 1g --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=256m,mode=1777 -e HOME=/tmp gameflex/browser-runner:0.1.0 node runner/sandbox-check.mjs
scripts.sandbox:selftest: docker run --rm -e SANDBOX_CHECK_SELF_TEST=1 --cap-drop ALL --security-opt seccomp=runner/seccomp/chromium-sandbox.json --shm-size 512m --pids-limit 256 --memory 1g --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=256m,mode=1777 -e HOME=/tmp gameflex/browser-runner:0.1.0 node runner/sandbox-check.mjs
